decisions.reason: This certified fire-resistant exterior door fits the firm's core safety and compliance capabilities, and after being kept through 2024 its performance likely meets aspiration levels well enough that a large firm would continue it.

After dropping narrower express programs A and B, the broader express line for doors and gates likely became the focal express offering, so management would keep it while concentrating resources on the stronger format.

The online ordering and digital services platform supports the firm's strategic move toward deeper service integration, and a large firm with organisational slack would usually continue refining it unless results were clearly far below aspirations.

A fire and smoke protection door is a close extension of the established compliant-safety portfolio, so absent evidence of serious shortfall management would keep this complementary product on the market.
